text:
sara-marketing: Heads-up — running a 2-part virtual office-hours series the week of May 12 for the launch. Need: registration page copy, timezone slots, Zoom recording + clip flow, and post-event lead routing. Who can own what?
kevin-ops: I can handle Zoom config + recording upload automation. Do we want multiple timezone windows or one rolling session?
lina-growth: Recommend 3 slots to cover APAC/EMEA/US: 8am PST, 4pm PST, 12pm PST — each 45min. Keeps CTAs consistent across slots.
alex-analytics: We need hidden CRM tags on reg page: event_intent (benchmark|demo|general), source_campaign, and preferred_followup_time. Also UTM -> HubSpot mapping.
sara-marketing: Draft consent line: "I consent to receive follow-ups and short clips from Redwood Inference about this event." Legal OK? Keep it one checkbox.
kevin-ops: Legal gave verbal ok, add link to privacy policy. For Zoom: passcode ON, waiting room OFF, cloud recording ON, set recording to host-only to avoid participant uploads.
opsbot: recording-bot: Cloud recording enabled for event_id=oh-2026-05-12. Will auto-upload raw mp4 to s3://redwood-events/oh-2026-05-12/full/3412345678.mp4 after session ends.
zach-prod: For clip auto-generation: use VTT transcript timestamps + speaker change detection to create 2–4 highlights per session. Thresholds: silence >3s and speaker confidence >0.6.
alex-analytics: Zapier mapping for reg -> HubSpot (draft):
```
POST https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/12345/abcde
Body (json):{
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "event_intent": "{{intent}}",
  "source_campaign": "{{utm_campaign}}",
  "preferred_time": "{{time_slot}}"
}
```
Use this to create contact + set property `event_intent`.
lina-growth: Follow-up cadence proposal: 1) immediate thank-you with calendar invite + replay expectation; 2) 24h highlight reel email with 3 clips; 3) 3-day targeted nurture by intent (benchmark -> benchmark deep-dive, demo -> AE outreach).
sara-marketing: Ownership question: do we auto-send raw clips to AEs or have video-team edit? My preference: auto-generate clips, let video-team do 1-2 quick trims, then push to AE queue. Keeps speed high.
video-team: We can trim and tag clips within 24 hours, but need clear naming convention from ops (eventid_date_clip#).
kevin-ops: Naming convention agreed: `{event_id}/{YYYYMMDD}/clip_{n}_{start_ms}_{end_ms}.mp4` and metadata JSON beside each clip with transcript snippets. Example: 
`redwood-events/oh-2026-05-12/20260512/clip_1_00000_012345.mp4`
hubspot-bot: hubspot-bot: Created properties `event_intent`, `preferred_followup_time`, and `clip_owner` on 2026-05-01. Mapping saved to marketing workspace.
alex-analytics: Also capture attendee engagement score (0-100) computed from watch percentage + chat activity; push as `event_engagement_score` property for routing.
lina-growth: Routing rules: engagement >=70 and company_size >=100 -> AE immediate task; else nurture track. Add `preferred_followup_time` to schedule outreach.
kevin-ops: Implementation notes: Zoom -> S3 upload via recording-bot, then trigger clip-splitter lambda which emits clip metadata to /events/processing queue. Zapier listens for contact creation and sets `clip_owner` via simple mapping (size buckets).
opsbot: deploy-bot: Scheduled cloud recording retention policy = 90 days for marketing events. Clips flagged for AE will persist 180 days.
sara-marketing: Final asks before I push reg page draft: confirm consent copy, confirm Zoom settings, confirm clip naming + AE routing logic. I’ll drop copy by EOD.
kevin-ops: Confirmed all of the above. I’ll provision the Zoom meeting templates and S3 bucket paths today.
alex-analytics: I’ll validate HubSpot property mapping and test a full-registration -> contact create flow by tomorrow.
lina-growth: I’ll prepare the three email templates and variation for each intent bucket.
sara-marketing: Awesome — thanks team :party_parrot: :thumbsup:
